info.name: Falcon E-Commerce Customer Mobile App APIs
info.description:
# Falcon E-Commerce Customer Mobile Application API Collection

This collection contains **ONLY Customer/Shopper APIs** tailored for Mobile Application Developers (Flutter / React Native / iOS / Android).

### Quick Start Guide:
1. **Environment Variables**:
   - `baseUrl`: Default `http://localhost:5001` (change to your staging or production server URL)
   - `customerToken`: Auto-populated when you call **Login** or **Register Customer**.
2. **Payload Structure**:
   - Every POST / PUT request body includes **both REQUIRED and OPTIONAL** fields.
   - Each request description provides a full field specification table.
3. **Language Support**:
   - Pass `Accept-Language: ar` or `Accept-Language: en` header if needed.

variable.description: Backend API base URL (e.g. http://localhost:5001 or https://api.yourdomain.com)
JWT Bearer access token (automatically populated after calling Login or Register)

item.name: 1. Authentication & Onboarding
item.description: Customer registration, login, phone/email OTP verification, token refresh, and profile check.

request.description:
### Register Customer Account

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | **REQUIRED** | String | Unique username (e.g., `ahmed_saudi`) |
| `email` | **REQUIRED** | String | Valid email address |
| `mobile` | **REQUIRED** | String | Saudi mobile with country code (e.g., `+966501234567`) |
| `password` | **REQUIRED** | String | Password (min 6 characters) |
| `first_name` | **OPTIONAL** | String | First name (auto-derived from username if omitted) |
| `last_name` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Last name |
| `verificationCode` | **OPTIONAL** | String | OTP code if pre-verified via send-code |

### Customer Sign In

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `loginInput` | **REQUIRED** | String | Email, mobile number (+96650...), or username |
| `password` | **REQUIRED** | String | User's password |

### Send Verification Code (Mobile OTP or Email OTP)

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | **REQUIRED** | String | Mobile number (e.g. `+966501234567`) or email address |
| `type` | **OPTIONAL** | String | `'mobile'` (default) or `'email'` |

### Verify 6-digit Code

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | **REQUIRED** | String | Mobile number or email address |
| `code` | **REQUIRED** | String | 6-digit verification code |
Check if a username is available in real-time during registration. Returns suggestions if taken.
Check if mobile number is already registered before signup.
Fetch basic session and user info of currently logged-in customer.

### Refresh Access Token

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `refreshToken` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Refresh token if not using HTTP-only cookies |

### Log out and invalidate customer session

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `role` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Value `'CUSTOMER'` |

item.name: 2. Customer Profile & Addresses
item.description: Manage customer profile info, stats, membership tier, and delivery addresses.

item.name: Get Customer Full Profile & Loyalty Stats

request.description: Fetches full customer profile including loyalty points (martPoints), tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold), total orders, active orders, and addresses count.

item.name: Update Customer Profile (Full Body Required & Optional)

request.description:
### Update Profile Details

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `first_name` | **OPTIONAL** | String | First name |
| `last_name` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Last name |
| `email` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Email address |
| `mobile` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Mobile number |
| `dob` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `gender` | **OPTIONAL** | String | `'MALE'` or `'FEMALE'` |
| `national_id` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Saudi National ID / Iqama |
| `avatar_url` | **OPTIONAL** | String | URL of uploaded avatar image |
| `preferences` | **OPTIONAL** | Object | App preferences (language, notification settings) |
Returns all saved delivery addresses for the logged-in customer.

item.name: Add Delivery Address (Full Body Required & Optional)

request.description:
### Add New Delivery Address

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full_name` | **REQUIRED** | String | Recipient full name |
| `mobile` | **REQUIRED** | String | Recipient contact mobile number |
| `city` | **REQUIRED** | String | City (e.g. Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam) |
| `area` | **REQUIRED** | String | Neighborhood / District (e.g. Al Olaya) |
| `address_line` | **REQUIRED** | String | Street name, Building number, Apartment/Villa |
| `address_type` | **OPTIONAL** | String | `'HOME'` (default), `'WORK'`, or `'OTHER'` |
| `is_default` | **OPTIONAL** | Boolean | Set as primary default address (default: `false`) |
| `postal_code` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Postal / ZIP Code |
| `landmark` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Nearby landmark for driver delivery |
| `latitude` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | GPS Latitude coordinates |
| `longitude` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | GPS Longitude coordinates |
| `country` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Default `'Saudi Arabia'` |

body.raw:
{
  "full_name": "Ahmed Al-Mansour",
  "mobile": "+966501234567",
  "city": "Riyadh",
  "area": "Al Olaya",
  "address_line": "Building 42, Floor 3, Apt 12, King Fahd Road",
  "address_type": "HOME",
  "is_default": true,
  "postal_code": "12211",
  "landmark": "Opposite Kingdom Tower",
  "latitude": 24.7136,
  "longitude": 46.6753,
  "country": "Saudi Arabia"
}

item.name: 3. Home & Browsing

item.name: Get Public Homepage CMS Layout (Published Sections)

request.description: Fetches complete published homepage structure, including banner sliders, promotional product sections, deals of the day, and category carousels.
Returns top hero slider banners with image URLs, click redirect links, and titles.
Returns middle and promotional grid banners for mobile homepage feed.

request.description: Returns active category sections with their sub-items and banners for the home feed.

item.name: 5. Products & Multi-Variant Images
item.description: Product catalog browsing, search, multi-variant images gallery, prices, and stock.

query.description: [OPTIONAL] Search query keyword in title or description

request.description: Search and filter products catalog. Each product includes main images, pricing, and variants array.

item.name: Get Product Detail By ID (With Multi-Images per Variant)

request.description:
Fetches full product details including:
- `product_images`: Main product images gallery
- `variants`: Array of variants (e.g. 1L, 2L, 500g)
- `variants[].images`: Up to 5 images per variant with `is_primary` flag and `sort_order`
- `price`, `special_price`, `sku`, `stock_quantity` per variant.

item.name: 6. Cart Management
item.description: Customer shopping cart: add items (standard or variant), update quantities, totals calculation.

request.description: Returns cart items, subtotal, discount, VAT, delivery fee, and grand total.

item.name: Add Item to Cart (Single Product OR Variant Product)

request.description:
### Add Product to Cart

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productId` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Product ID to add |
| `quantity` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | Quantity to add (default: `1`) |
| `variantId` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | Variant ID (REQUIRED if product has variants e.g. 1L, 2L) |

### Update Quantity

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `quantity` | **REQUIRED** | Number | New quantity (integer >= 1) |
Removes specific line item from customer cart.
Removes all items from the customer cart.

item.name: 7. Coupons & Delivery Slots
item.description: Discount vouchers and delivery schedule selection for checkout.

request.description: Returns list of active promo coupons customer can apply at checkout.

### Validate Coupon

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | **REQUIRED** | String | Coupon code (e.g. `WELCOME10`, `RAMADAN25`) |
| `subtotal` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Cart subtotal amount |
Returns available delivery slots (e.g. Morning 09:00 AM - 12:00 PM, Evening 05:00 PM - 09:00 PM) and express delivery availability.

item.name: 8. Orders & Checkout
item.description: Place order from cart, view order history, track order status, cancel, and reorder.

item.name: Create Order (Place Order - Full Body Required & Optional)

request.description:
### Place Order from Cart

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `addressId` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Selected delivery address ID |
| `paymentMethod` | **REQUIRED** | String | `'CASH_ON_DELIVERY'` \| `'BANK_TRANSFER'` \| `'ONLINE'` |
| `deliverySpeed` | **OPTIONAL** | String | `'STANDARD'` (default) or `'EXPRESS'` |
| `deliveryDate` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Scheduled delivery date (YYYY-MM-DD) |
| `deliverySlot` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Selected slot (e.g. `'09:00 AM - 12:00 PM'`) |
| `couponCode` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Promo coupon code to apply |
| `notes` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Delivery instructions or special notes |

body.raw:
{
  "addressId": 1,
  "paymentMethod": "BANK_TRANSFER",
  "deliverySpeed": "EXPRESS",
  "deliveryDate": "2026-10-27",
  "deliverySlot": "09:00 AM - 12:00 PM",
  "couponCode": "WELCOME10",
  "notes": "Please call upon arrival. Ring the blue doorbell."
}

request.description: Returns customer's order history with items, prices, status, and tracking numbers.
Returns complete details for a specific order (items, addresses, delivery info, invoices).
Fetches order confirmation summary right after successful checkout.
Real-time tracking of order milestones: Order Placed -> Confirmed -> Packed -> Driver Assigned -> Out for Delivery -> Delivered.

### Cancel Order

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | **REQUIRED** | String | Reason for cancellation (e.g. `'Changed my mind'`, `'Found a better price'`, `'Delivery delayed'`) |
| `remarks` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Detailed remarks or notes |

### Reorder Items

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preview` | **OPTIONAL** | Boolean | Set `true` to check current prices & stock availability without modifying cart. Set `false` to add items to cart. |
| `allowAnyStatus` | **OPTIONAL** | Boolean | Allow reordering regardless of original order status (default: `false`) |
| `customSelections` | **OPTIONAL** | Array | Optional subset of product IDs to reorder |

item.name: 9. Payments
item.description: Payment confirmation for bank transfers and online gateway verification.

request.description:
### Submit Bank Transfer Payment Proof

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | **REQUIRED** | Text | Order ID |
| `bankName` | **REQUIRED** | Text | Name of bank (e.g. Al Rajhi Bank, SNB, Riyad Bank) |

item.name: Verify Online Gateway Payment (Razorpay / Cashfree / Mada / Apple Pay)

request.description:
### Verify Payment Gateway Response

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Order ID |
| `gateway` | **REQUIRED** | String | Gateway identifier: `'RAZORPAY'` or `'CASHFREE'` |
| `razorpay_payment_id` | **REQUIRED (if Razorpay)** | String | Payment ID from Razorpay SDK |
| `razorpay_order_id` | **REQUIRED (if Razorpay)** | String | Order ID from Razorpay SDK |
| `razorpay_signature` | **REQUIRED (if Razorpay)** | String | HMAC SHA256 signature |
| `cashfree_order_id` | **OPTIONAL (if Cashfree)** | String | Order ID from Cashfree |
| `cashfree_payment_id` | **OPTIONAL (if Cashfree)** | String | Payment ID from Cashfree |

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `productId` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Product ID to add or remove |

item.name: 12. Order Feedback & Ratings
item.description: Customer reviews and 1-5 star ratings for orders and products.

item.name: Submit Order Rating & Feedback (Full Body Required & Optional)

request.description:
### Submit Feedback

| Field | Status | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orderId` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Order ID being rated |
| `rating` | **REQUIRED** | Number | Rating score from 1 to 5 |
| `comment` | **OPTIONAL** | String | Customer review text |
| `productId` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | Specific product ID being reviewed |
| `orderItemId` | **OPTIONAL** | Number | Specific order item ID |

body.raw:
{
  "orderId": 1,
  "rating": 5,
  "comment": "Fresh items and very prompt delivery! Excellent packaging.",
  "productId": 1,
  "orderItemId": 1
}

request.description: Returns feedback previously submitted for an order.
